svg.text: SECTION A-A (THROUGH TOOTH T1 AND MAGNET 1)
Lams: Motorneo / Polaris / Precision Micro; wind in-house
1. Press bearings (3) into base (1) with Loctite 641 on OD only; seat on shoulders with flat anvil, <= 300 N, no load through balls.
2. Bond stator (2) on tube with Loctite 638; align lead exit to window W1; cure 24 h RT or 15 min 120 C.
3. Bond magnets (8) into ring (7) with Loctite AA 326 + SF 7649 using alternating-pole indexing fixture; check pole order with compass.
4. Press ring into bell (6) (H7/s6, Loctite 638). Press shaft (4) into hub, fit grub (9) with Loctite 243 on flat.
5. Balance rotor (6+7+8+4): residual unbalance <= 11 mg·mm (ISO 21940-11 G2.5 at 36,000 rpm, rotor 16.6 g).
6. Insert rotor, add shim (10), fit e-clip (5). Axial play 0.02-0.08 mm; rotor turns freely, cogging uniform.
7. End-of-line test: R line-line, hipot, no-load Kv at 12 V (spec in spec_sheet.md), current, vibration, noise.
REV P1 - PROTOTYPE - GENERATED FROM PARAMETRIC MODEL - VERIFY AGAINST STEP BEFORE ORDERING
